text:
emi (Design): Quick sync on vectors preview + export behavior. We had a support ticket where exported CSV had unexpected order and missing pinned columns. Want to standardize: export should reflect the visible column order and include pinned columns by default with a clear toggle.

jonah (PM): Yup. Current problem: primary CTA reads 'Export selection' but the modal defaults to exporting 'All columns'. Users think they're exporting only the shown columns. Proposal: make CTA text explicit like 'Export selected rows (columns configurable)'. Modal header: 'Columns to include in export'.

max (Eng): Implementation detail: front-end keeps two arrays: selectedRowIds and visibleColumns. We can pass both to the export modal and backend. Sample payload:
```
{
  rows: selectedRowIds,
  columns: visibleColumnsWithPinnedFirst,
  includePinned: true
}
```
We'll also strip UI-only columns (e.g., 'rowActions') before sending.

sara (DevEx): Copy note: shorter CTAs are better for toolbars. Maybe primary CTA 'Export selected rows' and secondary link 'Export full dataset'. In the modal, helper text: 'Pinned columns are included by default. Uncheck to exclude.' Keyboard focus should land on column checkboxes.

aria (a11y): Accessibility checklist: modal must have role="dialog" and aria-modal="true". Use aria-labelledby for the header. When export completes, announce with an SR-only live region: 'Export ready: 8 rows. Download started.' After download, focus should return to the export button. Ensure all checkboxes have visible focus rings and accessible labels.

nina (Research): From interviews: power users expect file name to indicate type of export. Suggest default filename pattern: `vectors-selected-YYYYMMDD.csv` when selection exists, and `vectors-all-YYYYMMDD.csv` otherwise. Also, many mentioned they want pinned columns (ID, score) first in CSV.

emi (Design): Agree on naming. Modal copy suggestions: header -> 'Choose columns to include', toggle label -> 'Include pinned columns (sticky)'. Add small helper under toggle: 'Pinned columns stay at the start of the file.' Also show a small preview of the first 3 columns in the modal.

max (Eng): I'll make sure backend accepts ordered arrays and that we send columns in the desired order. One catch: our existing CSV generator accepts column keys; we'll need to map visible column ids to backend column names. I'll add a mapping layer and filter out private columns in Private deployments.

jonah (PM): Action items: max -> PR to pass ordered columns, includePinned flag and strip UI columns; aria -> add SR messages + keyboard tests; sara -> finalize compact CTAs and helper copy; emi -> update modal mock with column preview and filename patterns; nina -> add interview quotes to ticket to justify default pinned inclusion.

emi (Design): Small microcopy variants to pick from:
- CTA primary: 'Export selected rows'
- Modal header: 'Choose columns to include in export'
- Toggle: 'Include pinned columns (sticky in table)'
- Default filename: 'vectors-selected-<date>.csv' / 'vectors-all-<date>.csv'

max (Eng): I'll target the PR for the next pick-up. Quick dev note: keep export operation async; show progress and an option to email the link when large.

aria (a11y): Also add a test for keyboard-only flow where a user opens export modal, tabs to checkbox, toggles pinned option, and starts export. Ensure SR messages read in correct order.

emi (Design): Thanks team. I'll attach updated Figma frames and iterate copy after we have the PR.
